Some questions must be answered with a cross in a box    . If you change your mind about an
     answer, put a line through the box  and then mark your new answer with a cross    .

1  Water is an important biological molecule.

   Read through the following description of water.

   Complete the description by writing the most appropriate word on the dotted lines.


   Water has an uneven charge distribution so it is described as a

          ............................................................................................. molecule. The hydrogen ends of the molecule

   have a very slightly  ............................................................................................. charge.

   Water is involved in the transport of substances so it is an important

          ............................................................................................. in living organisms.

   Water is needed in chemical reactions called  .............................................................................................

    reactions that break down disaccharides such as

          ............................................................................................. into glucose and galactose.

                                                           (Total for Question 1 = 5 marks)
